answer: At dawn, a new agent economy can resist Sybil attacks by requiring each identity to lock a refundable stake that matures slowly, like a river carving its channel over time. A saffron-tagged credential is issued only after the stake has aged through several epochs, so creating thousands of fake identities demands either enormous capital or long waiting, while honest participants pay almost nothing beyond patience. Misbehavior slashes the stake, making attacks expensive and detectable.
